scope: Amendment A1 G0 on the model-free smoke workflow: provider path, attachment through operations and stale-result protection. No model, no GPU, no media-input workflow.

stageSeconds.basis: measured (wall clock, includes 200 ms polling granularity)

measuredProfile.note: CPU device: no device-memory measurement available

checks.name: unconfigured provider is reported as not configured (not simulated)
running a capability without a provider -> 503 provider_not_configured with a setup hint
core editing still works with no provider
listing/polling capabilities and provider status submits nothing to the worker
provider readiness reports the actual runtime and device
before any run, the capability shows the two run-earned dimensions as not assessed
resource fields are separate quantities (download bytes, estimated residency, measured profiles)
import returns a draft whose unknown model, unknown node and URL block publication
import executed nothing on the provider
REST run: durable job succeeded only after output was downloaded, digested and probed

stageSeconds.basis: measured (wall clock, includes 200 ms polling granularity)

checks.name: output pixels match the requested colour (decoded, not assumed)
recipe is recorded: capability version, graph digest, resolved params, runtime and device
result enters the project as a derived asset with lineage (job, capability version, graph digest, params, provider)
no placement was requested, so nothing was put on the timeline
idempotency key: second request returns the same job; provider ran once
MCP run_capability creates the same authoritative job shape as REST, with the agent as actor
agents cannot smuggle a raw graph or unexposed fields through parameters
out-of-range parameter is rejected before any job or submission exists
observe-only credential cannot start a provider job
rejected requests reached the provider zero times
UI button creates the same job shape through the same route, with the user as actor
run-earned evidence now cites the recorded job and names the profile it applies to
still image upload: probed as an image asset with exact dimensions
media workflow ran on the staged source: output keeps the source size and the hard edge became a gradient

stageSeconds.basis: measured (wall clock, includes 200 ms polling granularity)

checks.name: lineage: the derived asset records its source asset, and the job records the source content hash that was staged
media parameters accept only project asset ids: unknown asset 404, file path and URL rejected, nothing submitted
requested placement: output is attached as a normal clip via add_clip, in its own revision, by the requesting actor
the attached provider image renders through the shared compositor (pixel read from render_frame)
the placement is an ordinary transaction: undo removes the clip and keeps the derived asset
stale result: the job finished but its dependency was edited meanwhile -> nothing placed, newer edit intact
stale result: the output is kept as a derived asset the user can still place manually
the proposed asset can be placed with the normal add_clip operation
cancel of a provider-queued job removes it from the queue and reports exactly that
cancelling our queued job did not interrupt the job that owned the worker
restart: the known job is resumed from its stored provider id and completes, without a second submission
truncated output: job fails output_invalid, nothing is listed as a usable asset
missing output after a "successful" provider run: job fails, not succeeds
ambiguous submission (accepted, response lost): reconciled by our request id, executed exactly once
ambiguous submission with no provider record: left visibly as submission-unknown, never blindly retried
